title: Toolkits for options trading
author: 0lawy
selftext:
https://whop.com/risk-ninja/

I studied finance and economics at LSE and passed CFA Level I, and I kept running into the same problem in my own trading. I'd size a trade on feel and only find out the real max loss once I was already in it. So I built the tool I wanted.  
It's called Trader's Toolkit Pro. It's a single HTML file that runs offline in any browser. There's no account, no subscription and no cloud, and your data stays on your device.  
What's inside:  
Strategy Lab: Black-Scholes pricing and Greeks, plus a 3D P&L chart with a time slider and exact max profit and loss. It has 10 presets (spreads, iron condors, straddles and more) or you can build custom legs. For cash-secured puts and covered calls it shows cash needed, return on cash and simple annualized yield.  
Position Sizer: Set a risk % (0.5, 1 or 2%) with entry, stop and target. In sell mode it sizes spreads by max loss and cash-secured puts by cash needed, and it never sizes above your account.  
Trade Journal: R-multiples, tags, a P&L calendar, CSV import and export, and wheel tracking (assigned, called away, expired).  
Performance stats: Equity curve, win rate, average R, expectancy, max drawdown, streaks, and P&L by setup or tag.  
Backup and restore: Everything goes to one JSON file. You can pick USD, EUR, SEK or GBP, and there's light and dark mode.  
Here's an example of why I care about this. Selling a Ford $11 put for a small credit can look like easy money. The toolkit shows the gain is about $10 while the max loss is around $1,090. Seeing that before you click changes how you size.  
Some honest limits: the pricing is European-style with a single IV (no skew or early assignment), it doesn't calculate broker margin, and the backup file isn't encrypted.  
It's $34.99, paid once: whop.com/risk-ninja/trade…
